components.css: .ds-card{max-width:470px;display:grid;gap:14px;background:#06252A;color:#EAF1EE;border:1px solid rgba(227,201,141,.22);border-radius:24px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.45);font:16px/1.55 'Albert Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-card h2{font:400 40px/1 Gloock,Georgia,serif;margin:0;color:#fff}.ds-card p{margin:0;color:#C5D1D2}.ds-pill{justify-self:start;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(227,201,141,.55);color:#E3C98D;font:600 12.5px 'Albert Sans',sans-serif}

narrative.overview: A calm, premium property brand at dusk. The official FGEHA master plan in 3D is the stage; dark teal cards carry the facts; gold is the warm accent; rose is the one colour that asks the visitor to act.
keyCharacteristics: Dark teal cards over a quiet plan

rules.name: The One Rose Rule
rules.body: Rose is only for the call to act and the block or plot in focus.

rules.name: The Quiet Plan Rule
rules.body: The 3D plan stays neutral; no colour wash over all blocks.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase label above a heading.

dos: Date and source next to every figure
Test on a 390px phone and a laptop, light and dark
donts: A rose wash over the plan
